name: Ever Supreme Bio Technology Co., Ltd
summary: This enterprise is dedicated to the investigation, advancement, and creation of pharmaceutical treatments leveraging human mesenchymal stem cells and immune cells. Its current portfolio features UMC01, a drug candidate undergoing Phase I clinical evaluation for addressing conditions such as myocardial infarction and stroke. Additionally, ADCV01 is progressing through Phase II clinical trials as a potential therapy for aggressive brain tumors. The company also develops CAR001, an innovative chimeric antigen receptor immune cell product, alongside bone-marrow stem cells (BMSC) used in managing chronic stroke, severe osteoarthritis, and spinal cord injuries. Established in 2016, the firm operates from its headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.
